resources.string:
The thor-stickfx Magisk module must be installed, and this app added in Magisk → Superuser.

Magisk 31 no longer asks when an app requests root, so no prompt will appear. Add “Thor Sticks” with the + button in the Superuser tab, then tap this tile again.

Colour is set in Settings → AYN → RGB lighting; this tile only controls the effect layer on top of it.
